text:
Mikko Rantanen opened his last ten games with a hat trick against Boston and has kept the puck going in ever since: 9 goals and 21 points in 18 games for Dallas. The Stars control 56.3% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, 8.4 points better than without him.

The finishing, though, is running well ahead of the shots. He has 33 shots on goal all season and is converting 27% of them, against 16% last season, for 9 goals on 5.3 expected. That rate rarely lasts, and our range for his shooting sits nearer 15%.

There is also less of him lately. His ice time over the last ten games is down about a minute and a half a night, to 19:14.

None of that makes him less useful. His goals have swung results, 25th of 522 skaters in our wins added, and he still carries the puck in on 56% of his entries in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Our projection lands between 78 and 106 points, 91 in the middle.

What to watch: the shot count. More shots would cushion the fall in percentage.
